title: How to write descriptive alt text for social images
content:
# How to write descriptive alt text for social images

Alt text helps people who use screen readers understand non-text content in your posts.

## Start with the purpose

Describe what matters for the message, not every decorative detail.

## Link to your workflow

Run [social preflight](/social-media-accessibility-checker) before scheduling.
meta_title: How to write descriptive alt text for social images
meta_description: Practical alt text patterns for social teams, without keyword stuffing or redundant phrases.
answer_summary: Write alt text that conveys the image’s role in the post, using clear language and avoiding redundant phrases like “image of”.
key_takeaways: Skip alt text for purely decorative images when the platform allows it.
Preflight captions and alt text before publish.
